family_reports.body: They have taken my granddaughters away from a loving, caring family that they had a strong bond with. They never gave us grandparents a fair opportunity to care for our granddaughters.
The system has traumatized myself my kids and is tearing my five-year-old apart and myself
Has divided my children apart who were once very close, Causing Health problems seperated from grandparents who have always been there

They have torn apart my family and removed every resource my children has to assist them with taking part of their community. They have abused because of their disabilities and there has been no help for them since they left my home.

public_comments.comment_text: Violating due process pushing adoptions has a 75% reversal at appeal court ignored sides with the social worker report even though it is not written correctly. public_comments.comment_text: The judge acknowledged that we had a relationship with our granddaughters, but then denied our right to have meaningful visitation with them. Never ask grandparents if they wanted to care for the children. Denied our 388 without a court hearing the first time around. Allow the guardians to continuously intervene in the relationship with our granddaughters.

public_comments.comment_text: He allowed CFS 15 months of delays to search for evidence when they found out the original allegations were false. From there he allowed delay after delay. My case has been delayed for 3 years and now they are trying to adopt my children based on me being out of time although i completed services 3 times.
